boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Mary places for studying, gathering, reflection, performances, recreation, and campus meals.

cards.title: Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.subtitle: Campus gathering space
cards.notes: Use the fireplaces and sitting areas as a natural meeting point before heading to class, an event, or another campus destination.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor hub built for relaxing, gathering, and studying.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary describes the Lumen Vitae University Center as the heart of campus, with sitting areas where students, faculty, and visitors can relax and gather.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; follow posted building access and event rules.

cards.title: Lanterman Lodge
cards.subtitle: Inside Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Bring a conversation or a reading break to the open seating area, then take in the greenery, water features, aquarium, and fireplace.
cards.short_summary: A named lounge-like setting with natural features and open seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Lanterman Lodge has greenery, a fireplace, water features, an aquarium, and an open seating area.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located within the Lumen Vitae University Center; respect posted access rules.

cards.entity_name: Tom and Frances Leach Foundation Living Room
cards.title: Tom and Frances Leach Foundation Living Room
cards.subtitle: Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Choose a seat near the fireplace for a low-key check-in or reading session, and confirm whether nearby programmed events affect seating.
cards.short_summary: A named living-room space anchored by a fireplace in the university center.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary identifies the Tom and Frances Leach Foundation Living Room as a place where students can sit by a fireplace and enjoy Susanne’s across the hall.
cards.source_title: Lumen Vitae University Center | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Located in the Lumen Vitae University Center; seating may be affected by campus activity.

cards.title: Founders Hall
cards.subtitle: Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Check the university calendar for an open concert, lecture, or campus function, then arrive early to orient yourself in the hall.
cards.short_summary: A formal campus venue used for concerts and university functions.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary states that Founders Hall in the Lumen Vitae University Center hosts band concerts, the Big Band Dance, and the annual Jazz Festival.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Music at Mary | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Event and room access depend on the university calendar and reservations.

cards.title: Crow's Nest Campus Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Combine a meal with group work or a game at the tables; the lower level offers a quieter study-oriented dining area.
cards.short_summary: A dining venue with study seating, games, and all-hours student access during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Crow’s Nest as a social and study space with communal tables, printing, games, and 24/7 operation for students during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Crow’s Nest Campus Restaurant | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: University states it is open 24/7 for students during the academic year; food and beverages are purchased through dining arrangements or payment.

cards.title: Welder Library
cards.subtitle: Library and academic workspace
cards.notes: Use a computer workstation or settle in for focused work, then pause near the library’s Missouri River view when you need a reset.
cards.short_summary: A substantial campus library with seating, workstations, classrooms, and river views.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary says Welder Library seats 204 students, has 30 computer workstations, and contains classrooms and School of Arts and Sciences offices.
cards.access_notes: Library access and services are subject to current university policies and schedules.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Annunciation Chapel
cards.title: Our Lady of the Annunciation Chapel
cards.subtitle: Benedictine Center for Servant Leadership
cards.notes: Check the ministry schedule before visiting for Mass, prayer, or a performance; keep the space quiet when a service is underway.
cards.short_summary: A Marcel Breuer-designed chapel used for worship and large ensemble performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary says the chapel is in the Benedictine Center for Servant Leadership, was designed by Marcel Breuer, and hosts large ensemble performances.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Music at Mary | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Consult University Ministry for current worship times and observe posted chapel etiquette.

cards.title: Marian Grotto
cards.subtitle: Campus sacred outdoor space
cards.notes: Make this a short outdoor reflection stop between commitments; preserve the prayerful setting and leave the site as you found it.
cards.short_summary: A campus grotto dedicated to the Blessed Mother.
cards.evidence_claim: University Ministry welcomes visitors to the Marian Grotto, which is dedicated to the Blessed Mother, the university’s namesake.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sacred space; use respectfully and follow any posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Gift Hill Cross
cards.subtitle: Outside Lumen Vitae University Center
cards.notes: Add the memorial to a daylight campus walk and pause to read its setting in the university’s early campus history before moving on.
cards.short_summary: A campus cross memorial tied to the site’s 1958 property-blessing history.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary reports that Gift Hill Cross was used in the 1958 property-donation blessing and is now enshrined as a memorial outside the university center.
cards.source_title: The Harold Hamm Foundation Donates $10M and Continental Resources Donates $2M | University of Mary
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus memorial near the Lumen Vitae University Center; visit respectfully.

cards.title: Campus Fieldhouse
cards.subtitle: Indoor track and recreation facility
cards.notes: Look for scheduled recreation or athletics activity, then use the full-sized indoor track only during the facility’s approved access periods.
cards.short_summary: A fieldhouse with a full-sized 200-meter indoor track.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Mary’s campus gallery identifies a full-sized 200-meter indoor track in the lower level of the campus fieldhouse.
cards.access_notes: Recreation and athletics facilities operate on scheduled access and event availability.
